summary: Gorax previews the upcoming hero Child of Chaos in Dragonheir: Silent Gods, showcasing his character model, element switch mechanic, skill visual effects, and ultimate animation. Based on the preview, Child of Chaos is expected to be a highly versatile support hero who can change elements, inflict Attack Penalty, and apply enemy control or debuffs. Gorax recommends saving Heliolite Dice for his release.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: A highly versatile support hero featuring an Element Switch mechanic, Attack Penalty application, and strong debuff/control skill effects.

meta_changes: Introduction of Child of Chaos featuring a multi-element switch mechanic.
tips: Save Heliolite Dice for the release of Child of Chaos due to his element versatility and strong support kit.
